SET TIMES are laid across the window: evenly from doors to close where the close is known, an hour apart from doors where it is not, rounded to the half hour. RUNNING ORDER follows the billing - the billed headliner closes and the rest run in descending print, so "X with A, B" puts B first and X last, and "X + Y" is a co-bill where X closes.
